description: Check a crypto WALLET or contract ADDRESS for scam/sanctions risk before sending funds to it. Screens OFAC sanctions, known scam/drainer wallet lists, and on-chain reputation. Use for 'is 0x… a scam / safe to send to?'. Absence of a flag is NOT a guarantee of safety.

address.description: A wallet/contract address (0x… EVM or a Solana base58 address)

name: check_address
